newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk bourse to ask foreign investors for identity.
newsitem.headline: Turk bourse to ask foreign investors for identity.

text.p: The Turkish Capital Markets Board (SPK) will require all foreign investors at the Istanbul Stock Exchange to supply identification information from October 7, it said in a statement on Thursday.
The move, already in place for Turkish investors since last year, was aimed to determine the identity of investors involved in extraordinary buys or sells, it said.
It said all brokerage houses would have to ask for a document stating "details on the identity of the investing foreign banks, brokerages before accepting their orders for purchase and/or sale".
The custody bank of the exchange, Takasbank, will also be provided with the information, it said.
